Path: access-security.write-path-guards

## Triage: priority:p2 · domain:server · pm:queue · 2026-11-02T05:05Z

⛔ Not a claim.

- Read fresh. The clone and createMany handlers in packages/rest/src/crud-routes.ts never call `applyDroppedFieldsHeader` (packages/rest/src/error-response.ts), so these two doors report a readonly strip only in the body. That is inconsistent with the #3431 header contract that single create and update keep. It is a user-visible behaviour defect, so it is p2 in `domain:server`, and with the location and repro named it goes to `pm:queue`.
